region: Greenport · North Fork, Long Island, New York
about: January Spirits is the work of Jon Langley and Lucky Preksto, longtime New York City bartenders who met in 2009. In 2019 they ran pop-ups in Manhattan built around house-made amaro, vermouth and cordials, and in 2020 they began developing recipes in Langley’s kitchen. The name nods to Janus, the Roman god of beginnings and doorways. In 2022 they took their recipes to Matchbook Distilling Co. in Greenport, on Long Island’s North Fork, to produce at scale, and launched in spring 2023 with an amaro, a gin and a genepy.

The amaro blends twenty-one botanicals, led by coffee, roasted chicory, cardamom, dried orange peel and cacao nib, with the coffee and chicory a nod to New Orleans. It is sweetened with New York honey and rested for three months in used rye whiskey barrels before bottling. Matchbook, founded by Leslie Merinoff Kwasnieski and Brian Kwasnieski, is a bespoke distillery and incubator that makes spirits with bars, farmers and young brands like this one.

Writers tasting it have found old-fashioned birch beer, cold-brew coffee, clove-spiked orange and a cool thread of mint, and its distributor notes an incense-like nose. It is a New York amaro made by bartenders, for drinkers who know the Italian classics. Its coffee core makes it a natural companion to dessert, poured neat or over a single cube.
